reviewerRole: 2 fresh bounded display reviewers; disjoint saved-image batches
observations: Independent desktop-only pixel review of exactly the five supplied PNGs, opened once each through view_image in one batch. Both supplied JSON reports were read as text; all five image byte counts and SHA-256 hashes were independently checked against the desktop entries in the display report and match.

The whole-page image shows a nonblank, centered English lesson from its heading through its closing prose. Paragraphs, inline mathematical notation, all three figures, and the Figure 224, Figure 225, and Figure 226 captions remain separated, with no visible overlap, clipping, or unwanted horizontal page overflow at the inspected scale. The long vertical page is normal lesson content.

The opening desktop viewport visibly reads Current across the junction between p-type and n-type semiconductors and Printed page 264. The English donor/n-type and acceptor/p-type wording is readable, and italic n, p, and p - n notation renders without missing glyphs or collisions.
The inherited polarization filename actually contains the opening pn-junction viewport; it is not evidence for a polarization lesson.

Figure 224 visibly contains the complete divided sample outline with a legible n on the left and p on the right. These labels agree with the visible donor/acceptor prose; no separate donor or acceptor words are present inside the diagram.

Figure 225 visibly renders the complete circuit, n and p sample labels, A and V instrument labels, connection dots, adjustment arrow, and negative/positive terminal signs. The labels and symbols are distinguishable and are not obscured by circuit strokes or capture boundaries.

Figure 226 visibly renders three nonblank characteristics with distinct a, b, and c labels, I and V axis labels, negative-voltage labels where present, zeros, arrowheads, and curves. The visible lesson prose acknowledges qualitative characteristics and greatly different forward/reverse current scales; this review makes no new science or quantitative-scale judgment.

The width-binding report records approved SVG bytes and geometry as unchanged and the display report records 640-pixel actual desktop media width for each figure. Those supplied bindings are context only; source geometry, SVG generation, English fidelity, and source SCI approvals were not replayed.
All five requested PNGs were opened exactly once in one five-image view_image batch, with no source or desktop image opens.

The opening heading visibly wraps into three complete lines: Current across the junction / between p-type and n-type / semiconductors. It stays inside the mobile text column, with a separate Printed page 264 line below.

The native-size opening viewport shows legible English prose and italic semiconductor notation, including p - n, without visible glyph collisions, raw math markup, or horizontal clipping. The filename polarization is inherited; the visible opening is the pn-junction lesson.

The whole-page view is nonblank through the final paragraphs. Paragraphs, horizontal separators, three figure placements, and Figure 224, Figure 225, and Figure 226 captions remain visually separated. No unwanted whole-page horizontal expansion or text/figure/caption overlap is visible.

Figure 224 visibly fits its inline mobile area: both n and p labels, the outer rectangular boundary, and the central divider are complete and clear. The report records this media at 358 by 179 pixels, not fixed640.

Figures 225 and 226 retain fixed640 media inside 358-pixel scrolling containers according to the supplied report. Their saved mobile views show the initial visible portions only; intentional right-edge container clipping does not expand the prose column.

The visible part of Figure 225 is nonblank and clear: the n label, left circuit conductors and node, V meter, downward control arrow, and negative terminal are distinguishable without unintended visible overlaps.

The visible part of Figure 226 has a clear rising curve in a, readable I, V, 0, and a labels, and the left/central portion of b with its I, -V, and b labels. The surrounding prose visibly retains the qualitative-diagram and unequal-current-magnitude cautions; no equal-scale or quantitative-reading interpretation is introduced.
limitations: PASS applies only to these five saved desktop images of the isolated headless offline course display at the reported 1440 by 960 desktop viewport. It is not production, headed-browser, interactive, full-course, or cross-browser acceptance.

The whole-page image was presented downsampled. Not every heading, prose, caption, or mathematical glyph was inspected at native scale; the opening viewport and the three separate figure captures provide the bounded closer pixel evidence.

The opening viewport ends during continuing prose at its lower screen boundary. This ordinary viewport cutoff is not a claim that all opening-section lines fit in one screen, and no scrolling or additional captures were performed.
The separate figure captures show figure media rather than captions; caption placement was judged only in the whole-page image at its presented scale.
No mobile or source images were opened, and no mobile approval is given. No parent image, crop, or reopen was used.
Machine Chinese aria labels remain retained as disclosed in the supplied reports. Visible English rendering is not English accessibility certification; no accessibility inspection was performed.
Full English fidelity, source SCI, original geometry, SVG, and the qualitative forward/reverse characteristics were previously approved and are outside this review's scope.
No database, browser, network, paid call, Git operation, test, asset edit, chat operation, or delegation was performed. The only file written by this review is this JSON receipt.
PASS is restricted to the actual visible pixels in these five mobile captures. It is not desktop, production, headed-browser, physical-device, or complete-course acceptance.

The 390 by 7097 whole-page PNG was automatically downsampled to 330 by 6000 for viewing. Its overall layout and readable visible passages were inspected, but not every glyph was certified at native scale; no crop or reopen was used.
No horizontal gesture or interaction was performed or verified. Scrollability and fixed640 media widths come from the supplied text-only evidence, not an observed gesture.

Figure 225's right-side p region and label are cut by the container edge, and the remaining right-side circuit, ammeter, and positive terminal are offscreen. Those unseen portions are not approved here.

Figure 226's complete b panel and its right-side labels are not certified, and panel c is offscreen. Its qualitative and asymmetric-scale treatment is retained, without any new science or source-geometry review.
The opening viewport ends within continuing prose at the bottom of the 844-pixel capture; that viewport boundary is not treated as a page-layout defect.
English fidelity, source science, and original SVG geometry were already approved and were not replayed. No original source or desktop images were inspected.
Chinese machine aria labels are retained as disclosed by the reports. Pixel inspection does not certify English accessibility, screen-reader output, or keyboard behavior.

No database access, browser session, network or paid call, Git operation, test, renderer execution, asset edit, chat tool, or delegation was used. Only this requested review JSON was written.
